audit.why: 50.00% over 472 games — a genuine coin-flip, and diff EVEN / 6.0 matches. Two immobile control tanks; the lane rarely produces solo kills and the game tips on ultimate value.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four of seven stages are assigned against the page's own whys[] text. whys[1] says Cho'Gath gets 'the first-blood pressure in the early trade' but Level 2 is scored Shen; whys[3] and whys[4] both describe Cho'Gath owning the window ('I own the kill threat at 6', 'My Vorpal Spikes waveclear punishes his global R') but Levels 4-5 and Level 6 are scored Skill; whys[6] says 'the duel reads even' but 2+ items is scored Shen.
audit.why: The packet chart matches the whys row for row. Mechanically it is also right: at Level 2 Cho'Gath has Rupture and Shen's Shadow Dash is an 18-second, 150-energy button he cannot spam. At 6 Feast is a true-damage execute while Stand United (200/180/160s) contributes nothing to the 1v1. At two items neither tank kills the other, so the duel is even.
audit.corrected: Level 2 Cho'Gath (6/10), Levels 4-5 Cho'Gath (6/10), Level 6 Cho'Gath (6/10), 2+ items Skill (5/10, rating unchanged). Proposed as one atomic chart group across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) Twilight Assault (Q) deals damage based on the TARGET'S MAX HEALTH — never mentioned, and it is the reason a Feast-stacked Cho'Gath is a better target for Shen the longer the game runs. (b) The page attributes Shen's sustain to 'Q-empowered autos' in three places. Riot's text for Twilight Assault contains no healing at all; Shen's staying power is Ki Barrier (P), a shield he refreshes on every spell cast. (c) No cooldown or cost is given for Shadow Dash, the ability the whole page tells you to track.
audit.why: Riot text — Twilight Assault: 'dealing damage based on the target's max health... all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.' Ki Barrier: 'After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield.' Shadow Dash: 18/16/14/12/10s, 150 energy, 600 range. Spirit's Refuge: 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, blocks attacks only. Shen uses Energy, so the 140-energy Q and 150-energy E are a real early constraint. The page's existing claim that Spirit's Refuge blocks Vorpal Spikes autos but not Rupture or Feral Scream is CORRECT and is kept — Refuge blocks attacks, and Cho'Gath's Q and W are abilities.
audit.corrected: Max-health scaling stated in wants.foe[0] and phases[3].why; Ki Barrier replaces the invented Q-sustain in spikes[0].text and whys[0]; Shadow Dash's 18s/150-energy cost stated in dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the Refuge-blocks-attacks-only rule promoted into report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Shen Shadow Dash: His engage CC. Dodge it.' — the most punishable cooldown in the lane, described with no duration.
audit.why: 18s at rank 1 plus 150 energy is an enormous window; a baited Shadow Dash leaves Shen with no engage for a third of a minute.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.why: 'Shove the instant his Stand United channels' is a real and correctly-stated win condition — a 200s global with a travel delay leaves his turret undefended, and Vorpal Spikes clears fast enough to punish it.

notes: All three packet suspectNames for this matchup are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Drop Spirit's Refuge', 'My Feast' and 'My Vorpal Spikes' are correct names with a leading word attached. No name change proposed for them. Cho'Gath kit tags Rupture with a 'grounding' flag; Riot's description says it pops units into the air, so it is a knockup — I did not claim it grounds Shadow Dash anywhere. Whether Rupture's knockup can interrupt a Shadow Dash already in flight is not answerable from the kit files and is left unstated.
